stages.headline: Welcome! A teacher asked the class to add up all the numbers from 1 to 100, and nine-year-old Gauss answered in seconds.
stages.headlineEnglish: Welcome! A teacher asked the class to add up all the numbers from 1 to 100, and nine-year-old Gauss answered in seconds.

stages.headline: His secret was to add the numbers in pairs: 1 + 100, 2 + 99, 3 + 98… Every pair makes 101, and there are 50 pairs: 50 · 101 = 5050.
